Q: What is an undefined reference to '***@GLIBC'? A:

We have a generic undefined reference question or as yours has exp10 in it, maybe you'd prefer one specific to math functions.

In general the compiler put in a reference to a function and the linker did not find an implementation for it in the files it has been asked to link.

Q: Disable data tips by default A:

I found a method that works for me in R2024b:

set(groot , 'defaultAxesCreateFcn' , 'set(gca, ''Interactions'', [])')

The code sets a groot property such that, by default, all created axes have 'set(gca, ''Interactions'', [])' as their CreateFcn. This means that, immediately after the axes have been created, their 'Interactions' property is set to []. This gets rid of the data tip interaction, as well as other interactions (which I currently don't care about).

Including this code in the startup.m file ensures that it is run when Matlab starts.

The documentation pages that helped me come up with this are:

  • CartesianAxesInteractionOptions Properties.
  • Control chart interactivity.

Judging from the information on those pages, this approach may not work for some Matlab versions. I tested that it works in R2024b and in R2025b.

Q: Python script for automating the extraction of document links from a comapany network and writing to an Excel file A:

what is COMMON in column N to your lines is "...\0 Library\...###-...pdf" thus the filenames from library downwards are the ones that match that column and the candidates for a match in column M are those that have "...\0 Library\...###-...pdf" so there may be more in one column compared to the other but you can use character based filters on each column to ONLY select one on one this is why I said it is a filename task and filename listings are done using DIR on Windows OR import the full list as text and delete the NON matching pairings this how it would have been done in minutes (perhaps more than 60 :-) in Excel 97 (my favourite for this type of tast without needing VBA) but today VBA is better for finding matches.

Q: QML Listview - Button text is not displayed in the first row A:

Like others, I also could not reproduce the problem, but, I do have the following recommendations:

  1. Capture ListView.view into a property, so that it is always available when nesting
  2. Replace top-level Rectangle with either Pane or Frame
  3. With Pane/Frame sizing to contents, you only need to set RowLayout width so you don't need anchors.fill: parent

e.g.

Pane {
    id: decoration
    required property string name
    property var lv: ListView.view
    padding: 4
    width: lv ? lv.width : 0
    RowLayout {
        width: parent.width
        ...

Yeah I know. And in theory, if I were to get the samples from hospitals or medical university, I wouldn't even post this question. The data I currently gathered from Kaggle doesn't have any metadata, and the file format is .png, eventhough the actuals scans are almost always in .wsi ( Whole Slide Image).
